card.name: Study-reporting sentences in clinical data
card.fires_on: Sentence starters and connecting words right after study statistics, such as confidence intervals, patient counts or p-values. It appears in the results and methods text of clinical studies.

modes.label: Sentence start after statistics
modes.description: The first word of a new sentence that follows a result with numbers like CI or HR.

modes.label: Verb or comma inside study description
modes.description: A linking verb or comma in a sentence describing study size, design or incidence.

modes.label: Digits in p-values
modes.description: A digit within a p-value or a year range in reported results.
